briefing.headline: The Gameweek 11 deadline is Saturday 21 November at 11:00 UTC, and João Pedro, Gvardiol and Virgil-level injury news should be checked before you transfer.

points.text: The Gameweek 11 deadline is 21 November 2026 at 11:00 UTC.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: João Pedro (31.3% owned) has a thigh injury with an unknown return date. He is the most sold player.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: Gvardiol, Virgil, Guéhi, Belloumi and Manzambi are each flagged at 75% chance of playing.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: N.Jackson, Evanilson, Barry, Van Hecke and Vuskovic are the most bought players. Gabriel, Rice and Konsa are rising in price.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: Three players have four yellow cards, so they risk a suspension next gameweek.
